metadata.title: CSB-RNN: A Faster-than-Realtime RNN Acceleration Framework with Compressed Structured Blocks

title.excerpt: CSB-RNN: A Faster-than-Realtime RNN Acceleration Framework with Compressed Structured Blocks

authors.excerpt: Runbin Shi¹,²,*,†, Peiyan Dong²,†, Tong Geng³,†, Yuhao Ding¹, Xiaolong Ma², Hayden K.-H. So¹, Martin Herbordt³, Ang Li⁴, Yanzhi Wang²

language.excerpt: ABSTRACT Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been widely adopted in temporal sequence analysis, where realtime performance is often in demand.

discipline_classification.excerpt: This paper presents CSB-RNN, an optimized full-stack RNN framework with a novel compressed structured block (CSB) pruning technique.
discipline_classification.reason: 研究主题是循环神经网络的压缩、硬件架构与加速，属于计算机与人工智能系统研究。
